cases.explanation: The listed water bodies include lakes, streams, rivers and natural aquatic ponds, and they are described as an integral, life-giving source for the fishing community. The community regards the water body as a “mother” or “provider”. Statement (C) is incorrect because the description is not restricted to seas and oceans.

reasons: E1.1 says fishing communities regard the water body as “mother” or “provider” and lists seas, oceans, rivers, lakes, natural aquatic ponds and streams as integral, life-giving sources.
Thus (A), (B) and (D) are true; (C) is false because the description is not restricted to seas and oceans. Option A is the only matching choice.
The stem expressly asks about types, not whether fishing occurs at each particular site; no case-specific fishing activity needs to be assumed.
